name: AD825
type: High-speed JFET-input single op-amp, SOIC only
tagline: A cheap, fast single JFET op-amp (41 MHz, 125 V/µs, 12 nV/√Hz) that DIY rollers call punchy and rich.

lineage.note: Sole source; no second sources found. Exact year unknown: Rev. A predates 2/01; macro-models dated 1999.

part_numbers.note: Leaded SOIC-8 predecessor of AD825ARZ; probably obsolete. Futurlec and Mouser pages remain.
RoHS SOIC-8, tube and reels; DigiKey 505-AD825ARZ-ND. Probably active, lifecycle flag unconfirmed.
16-lead wide SOIC (R-16), added in Rev. F (10/04). Probably active (unverified).
Reel versions of the R-16 part; seen only in the EasyEDA library.

key_specs.value: Fully specified at ±5 V and ±15 V

reputation.summary: A niche cult part from the mid-2000s rolling era. Head-Fi users call it punchy and intimate, rich and thick, good for female vocals and strings. Others find it flat in some DACs, or more coloured and closed-in than the AD797. LC Audio sold AD825 upgrade parts. No objective measurements; all sonic claims are forum opinion.
typical_uses: DAC / CD-player rolling on SOIC-to-DIP adapters (two per socket)
Upgrade for AD711/AD712, e.g. Parasound HCA-2200 MK-I input
caveats: Single-channel, SMD only (SOIC-8 / SOIC-16); a DIP dual socket needs a two-chip adapter.
41 MHz part: adapter wiring and decoupling matter (no AD825-specific oscillation reports).
Tangentsoft test: 8.6 V supply for 2 V into 330 Ω (AD823: 6.1 V); 4.7 V for 0.5 V/33 Ω.
Praise is subjective forum opinion; no published THD+N measurements.
LME49990 reported smoother with firmer low end; one fan says 'AD825 is the best'.

counterfeit_notes: No AD825-specific counterfeit reports. Known orderables are SOIC-8 and wide SOIC-16 only, so a bare DIP-8 chip marked 'AD825' is suspect. Buy from ADI-authorised distributors (DigiKey 505-AD825ARZ-ND, Mouser, Farnell); check logo, date/lot code and marking.

part_numbers_affected: AD825AR-16 / AD825ARZ-16 (16-lead SOIC_W; inferred from the PCN's SOIC_W scope)
AD825AR / AD825ARZ (reportedly listed; doubtful, since these are 8-lead SOIC_N)
silicon_changes.summary: PCN 10_0117, 'Halogen Free Material Change for SOIC_W Products at Carsem': SOIC_W assembly moves from Carsem S to Carsem M with halogen-free die attach and mold compound, AEC-Q100 qualified. Plausibly affects AD825ARZ-16. Die unchanged.

spec_deltas.before: Carsem S; Ablestik 84-1LMISR4 or 8290 die attach; Sumitomo 6600H or G700 mold
spec_deltas.after: Carsem M; Henkel QMI-519 die attach; Hitachi CEL8240F10 mold (halogen-free)

silicon_changes.identification: Only SOIC_W (-16 suffix) in scope. Identify by date code after the PCN effective date and Carsem M assembly site.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: package materials and assembly site only; same die, pinout and datasheet
silicon_changes.verification: PCN confirmed as SOIC_W materials change, not die change. Listing of 8-lead AD825AR/ARZ is doubtful.
